source.caption: Figure 1. Illustration of the PEALD process and its ability to deposit crystalline, wafer-scale MoS 2 films of controlled thicknesses at low temperatures. (b) Raman spectra and ex situ SE thicknesses illustrating crystallinity and accurate thickness control. (c) SE thickness map over 4 ″ wafer (dots represent data points, film grown at 150 ° C, H2 flow ratio of 0.80, 50 ALD cycles).
